changes: 移除 Planner 本轮查询账本、查询快照、关键词/逐资产/完整分页校验和 search_required 返回；真实成功查询不再是提交准入条件。
独立保留 Planner 运行角色与任务匹配检查、资产审批、任务范围、队列模式锁及数据库精确去重。
准备新方向主动查相关 intent；监督/等待按需读取；已知资产 ID 直接复用，缺少身份或字段时才查资产。保留 8 条/8000 Unicode 字符图引导。
对齐共享检索参数和角色可用示例；修复仅允许未测试资产的 Planner 仍被提示普通 DSL 查询的问题。
新启动标记 planner_proactive_prompt_v1 升级已完成旧迁移的默认提示词；只匹配已知旧默认哈希，自定义原文保留并追加固定运行规则。

notes: Mock providers script their choices: tests verify first-request instructions and tool paths, not a real model guarantee to proactively search.
Normal query-then-add takes two tool calls and three mock requests both before and after. Add-first no longer pays the mandatory failed-submit/query/retry cycle.
The clearer fixed guidance adds approximately 512 Unicode characters in the 1000-node scenario (7070 -> 7582); no blanket Token saving is claimed. Counts exclude tool schemas and protocol framing.
No actual model usage or external model calls; characters/bytes are not Token measurements. Runtime and allocations are local synthetic measurements with normal environmental variation.
All querying remains model-driven. No backend automatic search, forced first tool, schema aliases or permission relaxation were introduced.
No SDK, original audit/conversation or business schema changes; no Git commit, service restart or deployment performed. Backend rebuild/restart is needed for runtime activation.
